basic_details.job_title: CSIR-NEIST Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 14 Project Associate, Project Scientist and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: CSIR – North East Institute of Science & Technology (CSIR-NEIST), Jorhat, Assam, is engaging 14 project staff on a purely temporary basis under Advertisement No. 10/2026-27-REC (PS) dated 13 November 2026: one Project Scientist-II, one Senior Project Associate, eleven Project Associate-I and one Project Associate-II, across seven research projects. Pay ranges from Rs.25,000/- to Rs.67,000/- per month plus HRA, depending on the post code and, for most posts, on NET or GATE qualification. Applications are accepted online only on the CSIR-NEIST project staff portal until 5 PM on 26 November 2026,

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Each post code has its own essential qualification and, for some, a desirable qualification. Candidates must meet the qualification of the post code they apply for. Along with the Doctoral Degree, the essential qualification requires 5 years' experience in Research and Development in Industrial and Academic Institutions or Science and Technology Organizations and Sciences. Experience in software development (Web portal); Electronics (robotics) and IoT based practical knowledge, science popularization project and also experience in student interaction for scientific demonstration. Research experience in molecular biology techniques, conducting metagenome/genome sequencing, bioinformatics for NGS data analysis in Python, Linux and/or R platforms, construction of MAGs, and microbiome analysis and interpretation. Highly motivated candidate with expertise in Organic Chemistry, Electrochemistry, Fundamental Analytical Techniques and Data Analysis with a strong ability to interpret results effectively. Candidates should have knowledge of computer for day-to-day work. Result awaited candidates need not apply. Project Staff presently working in CSIR-NEIST should take NOC for applying in other project vacancies. The maximum age is relaxable for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/Women candidates as per Govt. of India/CSIR rules issued from time to time. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post code.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: HRA is paid on top of the consolidated pay for every post code. For most Project Associate posts the pay depends on whether the candidate has NET or GATE qualification, as printed below. For Post Code 1010, the higher rate covers CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET or GATE qualifiers, or those who have qualified national level examinations conducted by central government departments and/or their agencies/institutions. The engagement is on a purely temporary basis for a specific period, co-terminus with the duration of the project, and will not confer any right for regularization in the institute. The project completion date may be extended or curtailed depending upon the grant of the Funding Agency. The maximum tenure of engagement of a project staff is six (6) years, counting engagement in different projects in the same institute or in different CSIR institutes. Project Staff may also be allowed to do PhD work based on CSIR Guidelines and with approval of C/A.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR-NEIST Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted online only, until 5 PM on 26 November 2026. The notice describes these steps: Signed copy of the registration form downloaded from the portal All original testimonials, including mark sheets and certificates A clear photograph Candidates who do not bring these on the interview date may not have their candidature considered.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Applicants will be shortlisted by the Project Team on the basis of academic performance and experience. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an offline interview at CSIR-NEIST, Jorhat. During selection, due weightage will be given to the academic performance and experience of candidates. The list of shortlisted candidates, with the final date and time of the interview, will be uploaded on the CSIR-NEIST website. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CSIR-NEIST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 14 posts under 12 post codes: one Project Scientist-II, one Senior Project Associate, eleven Project Associate-I and one Project Associate-II.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CSIR-NEIST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online application is 26 November 2026, up to 5 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for CSIR-NEIST Project Associate-I posts?
faq.answer: It depends on the post code: M.Sc in Chemistry, Botany or life-science subjects, a Master's Degree or M. Pharm, B.E./B.Tech in Civil or Mechanical Engineering, or BE/B.Tech in Computer Science or MCA after BCA/B.Sc (IT).

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for CSIR-NEIST project staff posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age is 40 years for Project Scientist-II and Senior Project Associate, and 35 years for Project Associate-I and Project Associate-II, counted on the closing date of the advertisement, with relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/PWD/Women as per Govt. of India/CSIR rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for CSIR-NEIST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Pay ranges from Rs.25,000/- + HRA for Project Associate-I to Rs.67,000/- per month + HRA for Project Scientist-II, with Rs.42000/- per month + HRA for Senior Project Associate.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the pay?
faq.answer: Yes. Every post code in the advertisement lists the pay "+ HRA".

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for CSIR-NEIST project staff posts?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that candidates need not pay any application fee.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for CSIR-NEIST Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online at https://neist.res.in/prostaff/ by clicking the post name of your post code, keep the Registration Number shown on screen, and bring the signed registration form to the interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for CSIR-NEIST project posts?
faq.answer: The Project Team shortlists applicants on academic performance and experience, and shortlisted candidates attend an offline interview at CSIR-NEIST, Jorhat.

faq.question: Q10. Can I apply for more than one post code?
faq.answer: Yes, but a separate application must be submitted for each post code.
